tasks.title: CHOOSE THE SLUG — before anything else. Create apps/<slug>/ if absent and copy engine/'s full content into it as the starting point. Add PROMPT_HISTORY/<slug>.md and seed apps/<slug>/BUILD_STATE.json — its first field must be "slug": "<slug>" (the value you chose). Commit + push immediately as push-access proof.
tasks.notes: Chose slug 'forge-companion'. Initialized apps/forge-companion from engine/, created PROMPT_HISTORY/forge-companion.md, seeded BUILD_STATE.json with slug 'forge-companion' as first field.

tasks.title: Set identity inside apps/<slug>/: namespace/applicationId in app/build.gradle.kts (derive a safe package, e.g. com.forgebuild.<slug with dashes removed>), app_name in res/values/strings.xml.
Adaptive icon via apps/<slug>/tools/make_adaptive_icon.py (create artwork if none supplied). Commit + push.
Confirm the repo-level signing secrets exist (see SIGNING & RELEASES); do not regenerate them.
Implement the app described in APP_DESCRIPTION, ONE FEATURE PER COMMIT/PUSH STEP, following the per-step protocol and quality constraints above.

Validate the build configuration, then release <slug>-v1 (see SIGNING & RELEASES: dispatch release.yml with app_path=apps/<slug>) and verify the release + APK asset exist via the GitHub Releases API on vjumbo264/forgebuild.
Set apps/<slug>/BUILD_STATE.json build_complete: true only after <slug>-v1 is verified live.

history.event: step-1 done: chose slug 'forge-companion', copied engine/ into apps/forge-companion/, seeded BUILD_STATE.json and PROMPT_HISTORY/forge-companion.md, verified push-access proof.

notes: Step 1 complete. Next: step-2 set identity (package com.forgebuild.forgecompanion, app_name ForgeBuild Companion).
